name: Permutation-Based Pairwise Coverage
description: Instead of defining a clique by stating that all items must be mutually connected, this method requires a property to hold across all permutations of the subset. By stating that the first two elements of every permutation must be connected, it logically enforces that all pairs are connected, but masks this behind sequence-validation terminology. Models relying on pattern-matching will fail to recognize the triangle-finding problem and either implement a naive O(n^3) permutation check that times out, or fail to apply the necessary bitset intersection optimization.
